headline: Taylor Swift celebrates Travis Kelce's first touchdown of 2026 season

sources.excerpt: Taylor Swift has savage celebration after Travis Kelce scores first touchdown of 2026 season. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end found the end zone against the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night at Arrowhead Stadium. Travis Kelce woke up Taylor Swift and the friends in her suite at Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday night in the first quarter of the Kansas City Chiefs’ matchup against the Indianapolis Colts. Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs capitalized on a turnover. Mahomes saw Kelce burst out to the right side. He caught the ball and ran into the end zone for a touchdown. It was a vintage play that so many NFL fans have seen for years. The score caused a raucous celebration from Swift. The NBC broadcast caught Swift pointing to her wedding ring as Kelce celebrated in the end zone. "That's my husband!" she shouted. Swift has been a mainstay at Arrowhead Stadium since the two began dating a few years ago. She and Kelce hard launched their relationship nearly three years ago when she showed up to support the legendary tight end when the Chiefs took on the Chicago Bears. Since then, it’s been a storybook romance for the two superstars. They got married at Madison Square Garden earlier this summer and began the next chapter of their lives together. Kelce, at 36 years old, isn’t exactly the same tight end he was in 2023. But the 11-time Pro Bowler and three-time Super Bowl champion has shown he can still make massive plays on the field when he’s called upon. His mere presence on the field is enough to cause the defense to keep a special eye on him. In the Chiefs’ 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos last week, he had three catches for 71 yards on five targets. Sunday night was Kelce’s first touchdown of the year and what a better way to do it than with your wife in the house.

Taylor Swift once again found herself at the center of attention during a Kansas City Chiefs game, but this time it wasn’t because of her music. During Sunday night’s game against the Indianapolis Colts, cameras captured the pop superstar celebrating after husband Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the 2026 NFL season. The moment quickly spread across social media and became one of the biggest talking points from the game. Swift watched from a suite at Arrowhead Stadium alongside her parents, Scott and Andrea Swift. When Kelce reached the end zone in the first quarter, television cameras showed Swift pointing toward her wedding ring while celebrating. Fans online quickly shared clips of the reaction, helping turn the moment into a viral story before the game was even over. The appearance marked Swift’s second Chiefs game in less than a week. She was also at Kansas City’s season-opening victory over the Denver Broncos. Reports said actor Tom Cruise joined Swift during that earlier game and later praised her growing knowledge of football during a television interview. Kelce’s touchdown gave Chiefs fans another reason to celebrate, while Swift’s reaction became a hit with viewers. The couple, who married earlier this year, continue to attract attention both on and off the field. As the Chiefs prepare for their next game, fans will likely keep watching not only for Kelce’s big plays but also for Swift’s memorable game-day moments.

Taylor Swift had plenty to celebrate after her husband, Travis Kelce, scored his first touchdown of the 2026 NFL season. The 36-year-old pop superstar cheered from her suite at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri, during the first quarter of the Kansas City Chiefs' primetime matchup against the Indianapolis Colts, as Kelce found the end zone for the first time this season. After the tight end's big play, cameras cut to Swift, who excitedly jumped out of her seat and pointed to her wedding ring while appearing to say, "That's my husband." NBC announcer Mike Tirico joined in, enthusiastically declaring, "And the woman with the ring. That's your guy!" The "Fate of Ophelia" singer, who married the NFL star at New York's Madison Square Garden on July 3, sported a sleeveless red Chiefs shirt and blue jeans while watching the game alongside her parents, Scott and Andrea Swift. Kelce and the Chiefs ultimately came away with a 33-30 overtime victory over the Colts. Sunday's game marked the second consecutive week Swift has attended a Chiefs matchup to cheer on her husband. Swift made headlines following the Chiefs' 2026 season opener against the Denver Broncos on Sept. 14, when she was spotted chatting with Tom Cruise in a box suite at Arrowhead Stadium. The movie star later revealed what they discussed while appearing on The Tonight Show several days later. "She was schooling me on football," a smiling Cruise told host Jimmy Fallon. "She was bringing the football. First of all, she's a genius. I've been following her since she was a kid," Cruise added. "Everybody there, all their friends, they're a beautiful couple and magical in their own right. Everybody there in that booth. I hadn't been to a football game since pre-COVID, where I was working and everything. So to get to hang out there and have that moment, it was a lot of fun … she knows her stuff." Kelce confirmed Swift's impressive knowledge of football during a bonus episode of New Heights posted Friday, which featured Cruise, who is promoting his new film, Digger.
